newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Kuchma vetoes Ukraine budget cash for ore refinery.
newsitem.headline: Kuchma vetoes Ukraine budget cash for ore refinery.

text.p: Ukrainian President Leonid Kuchma has vetoed a law passed by parliament that would have increased the budget deficit in order to finance construction of an ore refinery, his top aide said on Wednesday.
"Today, the president placed a veto on the law making changes to the budget to provide additional money for the factory," Yevhen Kushnaryov told a news conference.
Parliament voted on July 18 to raise the deficit by 0.1 percent to complete construction of the Kryvorozhsky Hirnycho-Zbahachevalny Zavod refinery in eastern Ukraine.
The 1997 budget deficit is set at 5.7 percent of gross domestic product, or four percent by International Monetary Fund standards. Parliament passed the budget only in late June.

Finance Minister Ihor Mityukov said this week his ministry and the presidential administration were seeking other sources of financing for the ore refinery, whose construction began in the Soviet era but was halted due to a lack of funds.
